2607.22393.title: SceneActBench: Can Agents Act on the 3D Scenes They See?
2607.22393.paper_summary: Vision-language model (VLM) agents increasingly use tools to act on 3D scenes rather than only describe them. Existing 3D benchmarks score textual responses or single-object operations, leaving agent action on complete multi-object 3D scenes under evaluated. We present SceneActBench, a benchmark for visually conditioned action across five 3D tasks under a unified agent-environment loop. Given PNG images or sampled video frames and, where applicable, supplied 3D assets, an agent acts on a 3D environment. We evaluate each final output against hidden ground truth with task-specific geometric metrics. SceneActBench comprises five tasks built from 210 source instances, yielding 520 task cases including paired input conditions. Every task runs through one fixed agent loop to keep the comparison fair. Across eleven proprietary VLM configurations, Overall scores span 38.6-50.2, and none performs consistently well across tasks. We further analyse where and how failures manifest.
2607.22393.paper_summary_zh: 視覺語言模型（VLM）代理人越來越多地使用工具來對3D場景進行操作，而不僅僅是描述它們。現有的3D基準僅對文本響應或單物體操作進行評分，導致對完整多物體3D場景中的代理行動評估不足。我們提出了SceneActBench，這是一個針對五個3D任務的視覺條件行動基準，並在統一的代理-環境循環下進行。給定PNG圖像或採樣視頻幀，以及在適用的情況下提供的3D資產，代理在3D環境中進行操作。我們根據隱藏的真實值和特定任務的幾何度量來評估每個最終輸出。SceneActBench包含五個任務，基於210個源實例，產生520個任務案例，包括配對的輸入條件。每個任務都通過一個固定的代理循環進行，以保持比較的公平性。在十一個專有的VLM配置中，總體分數範圍為38.6-50.2，且沒有一個在各任務中表現 consistently well。我們進一步分析失敗出現的地方和方式。
